description: SciGRID power (Scientific Grid Model of European Power Transmission Networks) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems. SciGRID is an open source model of the European transmission network. On the 15.06.2015 the first version (release V0.1) of SciGRID was released and the second version (release V0.2) was made available on the 20.11.2015. Coverage: Europe and Germany (any other EU country also possible). The fact sheet classes it as: Transmission Network Model. Sectors: Electricity Sector. Resolution: geography nodal resolution. Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Apache-2.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
